stories.title: Historic coal mine shafts force fresh changes to 300-home Hawarden development
stories.summary: A Hawarden councillor has demanded that the developer behind a 300-home Deeside housing site face the public over its latest plans, saying residents cannot understand what is being proposed. stories.title: Parents fury as Flintshire Council relaunches unchanged Catholic super-school plans
stories.summary: Parents who have spent 15 months campaigning to make their voices heard over Flintshire’s Catholic super-school plans have reacted with anger after the authority re-launched an unchanged proposal for consultation. stories.title: Online harassment reports to North Wales Police up 135% in two years, FOI shows
stories.summary: Recorded cyber-enabled harassment offences in North Wales have more than doubled in two years, according to figures released by North Wales Police.
